Delhi High Court denies SpiceJet's property submission plea

The Delhi High Court has rejected a plea by SpiceJet to submit a Gurugram property as an alternative to depositing ₹144 crore in a case involving Kalanithi Maran and KAL Airways. The court denied the airline's request for more time to deposit the specified amount.
